$comment: Private-store stub – describes the minimal REST API your internal app
catalogue must implement to serve OTA updates to managed devices.
Replace every '<PLACEHOLDER>' value with your real infrastructure.
This file is NOT read by any workflow; it is documentation-as-code.

latestRelease.description: Returns the latest release metadata for the given appId.

downloadApk.description: Redirects (HTTP 302) to the signed APK file.

reportInstall.description: Called by the MDM agent after a successful install.

authScheme.notes: Provision a short-lived token per device via your MDM platform.

mdmIntegrations.intune: Configure a custom managed app pointing to baseUrl/apps/{appId}/latest
mdmIntegrations.jamf: Use the 'Custom Apps' feature with the manifest endpoint above
mdmIntegrations.airwatch: Use the 'Internal Apps' feature; supply the download URL from the manifest
